dispositions.reason: The source describes a comrade trusted to protect one’s back, not someone one merely turns away from.
The source and surrounding memories identify an actual biological brother rather than a sworn blood brother.
The contact name is restored to the established glossary rendering, Designer-Brand Junkie.
The established name of the Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage allusion is required for the following Zhuge Liang joke.
Every reported form of address using Taekyung’s squad title in the chapter is standardized to the established term Captain.
The source contrasts a concealed purpose carried in the Head Elder’s heart with the physical sword at his waist.
Both instances of the Murim unit 갑자 are restored to the established term jiazi.
The formal Murim category 세가 is restored to its established rendering, great family.
The replacement preserves the source’s comparison of the Head Elder’s superiority by a full or half form.
Both reported forms of address using Taekyung’s squad title are standardized to Captain.
Samdo Sect and Gunggui Sect are the established names for the two identified members of the Five Gates of Shanxi.
Third Rate is a formal martial realm designation and therefore requires the established capitalization.
All reported uses of Taekyung’s squad title in direct address or reference are standardized to Captain.

patches.new: To them, I had been a Benefactor, a trusted superior, and a comrade they could trust to watch their backs.
patches.old: To them, I had been a Benefactor, a trusted superior, and a comrade they could turn their backs to.

patches.new: I was also his brother by blood.
patches.old: I had been a blood brother, too.

summary: Corrects trust and kinship meanings, restores established names and Murim terminology, clarifies the Head Elder’s metaphor and Lee Cheonbaek’s assessment, and standardizes Taekyung’s title as Captain.
